analyst.summary: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals is a global generics-plus-specialty pharma company whose multi-year return-on-equity figures look weak mainly because of a large one-off impairment charge taken in FY24 (likely related to its Ichnos specialty/innovation pipeline) rather than a core-business problem — current-year returns (ROE ~30.5%, ROCE ~40%) are genuinely strong, revenue growth has accelerated, and debt has been cut sharply. Underlying multi-year sales growth remains modest, and working-capital metrics have softened somewhat. We rate this a Hold.
